title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij: deaddrop_post extracts peer_eui64 twice (lines 97-109 and inside authorize_mutating)
description: deaddrop_post at coap_dtn.c:97-109 extracts peer_eui64 from sockaddr for rate-limiting, then authorize_mutating at coap_oscore.c:263-267 extracts it again for OSCORE ctx lookup. The outer extraction could be passed into authorize_mutating or removed in favor of extracting only once. Not a bug, but redundant code.
